A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TwinFlow and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. Matching content across pagination changes supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-generation experiments, image-editing results, ablations, and diversity analyses in Sections 4 and Appendices B and D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results and includes replacement generated-image examples.

M1.justification: Section 3.1 replaces the direct network-output fake sample with x_t minus t times the predicted velocity. Equation (9) uses F(z,0) and the reversed velocity difference. These correct the written sampling and loss specification; the architecture and combined loss components remain unchanged, and retraining is not established.

E1.justification: Training datasets and evaluated tasks remain unchanged: text-to-image generation on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and WISE, plus image editing on GEdit-EN and ImgEdit. Appendix D.3 retains the visualization prompts.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the main and appendix comparisons, including RCGM, SANA-Sprint, Qwen-Image-Lightning, VSD, DMD, SiD, sCM, and MeanFlow. Newly cited concurrent methods are not added to the reported evaluations.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain the same evaluation metrics, model configurations, training budgets, sample counts, resolutions, and timing procedures. The replacement Figure 3 examples retain the same displayed NFE and guidance settings.

E4.justification: Figure 3 replaces the poppy, butterfly, and cat examples used to examine visual quality across sampling steps, revising that qualitative comparison. The loss-balancing ablations, training-step analysis, diversity evaluation, and appendix trajectory visualizations remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain seed 42 in Table 6 and the same four-sample-per-prompt LPIPS averaging procedure in Appendix D.1. No repeated-run information or uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: Figures 1 and 3 contain different generated outputs, changing qualitative result entries. Numerical results remain unchanged throughout the tables and ablations, including Qwen-Image-TwinFlow's 1-NFE LoRA scores of 0.86 GenEval and 86.52 DPG-Bench.

T1.justification: Section 3.2 removes redundant outer gradients in Equations (4) and (6), reverses the velocity-difference definition, and corrects the Jacobian sign and gradient argument in Equation (8). These are substantive but localized derivation corrections; Appendix C.1's score-to-velocity derivation is retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: auxiliary-model-free one-step generation, strong low-NFE performance, and scalability to Qwen-Image-20B. Neither the claimed scope nor the headline performance claims change.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning diversity collapse, loss balancing, training progression, and the data-driven DPG-Bench gap are retained. The limitations concerning image editing and unvalidated video/audio applicability also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 3.1 explicitly documents the implemented fake-sample choice t=1, r=0 and its noise-based expression. The front-page model-access pointer changes to a Hugging Face collection. Existing training configurations and the code-access pointer are retained.

R1.justification: Appendix A adds a substantial concurrent-progress discussion covering ten additional works, including FACM, SoFlow, pi-Flow, Self-E, Decoupled-DMD, DMD-R, rCM, and TMD. This broadens the reviewed landscape across consistency, imitation learning, self-evaluation, and image/video distillation, while retaining the original novelty claims.

P1.justification: Changes are localized to the method explanation, the added concurrent-work discussion, and small front-matter edits such as the Ant Group internship credit. Most prose and the section hierarchy are retained.

P2.justification: Figures 1 and 3 are rebuilt with replacement images; Figure 3 changes row order and moves from below Table 2 to below Table 3. Appendix tables and figures reflow, including a nearly empty continuation page, but the overall visual organization remains similar.

improvement.justification: v2 improves mathematical consistency by correcting the fake-sample construction and rectification-gradient derivation, and makes implementation choices more explicit. The expanded concurrent-work discussion also improves context. These support a limited overall improvement; the quantitative evidence and central conclusions remain unchanged.
